< 50 NEXT N\r
< 60 LET S=0\r
< 70 FOR K=1 TO 100\r
< 80 S=S+K\r
< 90 NEXT K\r
< 100 PRINT "SUM 1..100 =";S\r
< 110 GOSUB 200\r
< 120 PRINT "10 FACTORIAL";F\r
< 130 FOR N=3 TO 41 STEP 2\r
< 140 P=1\r
< 150 FOR D=3 TO N-2 STEP 2\r
< 160 IF N/D=INT(N/D) THEN P=0\r
< 170 NEXT D\r
< 180 IF P=1 THEN PRINT N;\r
< 190 NEXT N\r
< 195 END\r
< 200 F=1\r
< 210 FOR K=2 TO 10\r
< 220 F=F*K\r
< 230 NEXT K\r
< 240 RETURN\r
